records.statement: Yamaha's 2023 YZ250 owner's service manual lists maintenance in race-based intervals (every race about 2.5 h, every third race about 7.5 h, every fifth race about 12.5 h) with YAMALUBE 2R premix at 30:1, 0.75 L of SAE 10W-40 transmission oil, and an NGK BR8EG plug gapped 0.5–0.6 mm.

Schedule.column assignment: The check marks placing each task in a column did not survive text extraction; only the items, tasks and explicit calendar intervals below are reliable.
Schedule.1 Piston (*): Check for carbon deposits and cracks or damage; clean; replace
Schedule.2 Piston rings (*): Check ring end gap and rings for damage; replace
Schedule.4 Cylinder head (*): Check for carbon deposits; clean; check head gasket for damage; tighten cylinder head nuts if necessary; replace cylinder head gasket
Schedule.5 Cylinder (*): Check for score marks or wear; clean; replace
Schedule.6 YPVS (*): Check for carbon deposits and cracks or damage; clean
Schedule.7 Clutch (*): Check clutch housing, friction plates, clutch plates and springs for wear or damage; adjust; replace
Schedule.8 Transmission (*): Change the transmission oil; check transmission for damage; replace bearings
Schedule.9 Shift forks, guide bars, shift drum (*: Check all parts for wear and damage; replace if necessary
Schedule.11 Kickstarter system (*): Check idle gear for damage; replace if necessary
Schedule.12 Exhaust system (*): Check exhaust pipe and muffler for carbon deposits; clean
Schedule.13 Crankshaft (*): Check for carbon deposits and damage; clean
Schedule.14 Carburetor (*): Check settings and for obstructions; adjust and clean
Schedule.15 Spark plug: Check condition; clean and regap; replace
Schedule.16 Drive chain (*): Check slack, alignment and condition; adjust and thoroughly lubricate with Yamaha chain and cable lube or equivalent; replace
Schedule.17 Cooling system (*): Check coolant level and for leakage; check hoses; check radiator cap spring operation; change coolant every 2 years
Schedule.18 Chassis fasteners (*): Check all chassis fittings and fasteners; correct or tighten if necessary
Schedule.22 Brakes (*): Adjust lever and pedal position; lubricate pivots; check disc surface; check fluid level and leakage; tighten disc, caliper, master cylinder and union bolts; replace pads; replace brake fluid every year
Schedule.23 Front fork (*): Check operation and oil leakage; adjust if necessary; clean dust seal and lubricate with lithium-soap-based grease; replace fork oil; replace oil seals; replace protector seal
Schedule.24 Shock absorber assembly (*): Check operation and adjust; tighten if necessary; lubricate with lithium-soap-based grease (after washing the motorcycle or riding in the rain)
Schedule.25 Drive chain roller and support guide: Check for wear or damage; replace if necessary
Schedule.26 Rear suspension (*): Check operation and tighten if necessary; lubricate with molybdenum disulfide grease
Schedule.27 Swingarm pivot bearings (*): Check bearing assemblies for looseness; lubricate with molybdenum disulfide grease
Schedule.28 Steering head (*): Check operation, free play, tighten if necessary; clean and lubricate with lithium-soap-based grease; replace bearings
Schedule.29 Tires and wheels (*): Check tire pressure, wheel runout, spokes, tire wear; tighten sprocket bolts if necessary; check wheel bearings; lubricate wheel bearings with lithium-soap-based grease; replace wheel bearings
Schedule.31 Throttle grip (*): Check operation; check free play and adjust if necessary; lubricate cable and grip housing
Schedule.(*): Items marked with an asterisk should be performed by a Yamaha dealer (special tools, data and skills).
